issues.description: Console warning: container has non-static position. A scroll offset calculation warning suggests some positioned element may not have relative/fixed/absolute positioning set.
issues.element: Some container element used for scroll offset calculation
issues.root_cause: A third-party component or custom scroll hook is referencing a container that has default static positioning. Likely in a particle canvas wrapper or scroll-based animation component in step-1 page.

issues.description: 400 error on a resource load (visible in console logs from /auth page, not step-1). This occurred on the auth page, not on the current step-1 page.
issues.root_cause: A fetch or image request on /auth page returns 400. Not affecting current step-1 screen.
